parameters.query: INSERT INTO discovered_sources (id, accelerator, company, domain, probe_result, promoted, found_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, false, now()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET probe_result = EXCLUDED.probe_result, found_at = now() RETURNING id, ($5::jsonb->>'confirmed')::boolean AS confirmed
INSERT INTO runs (workflow, started_at, finished_at, fetched, new_count) VALUES ('WF-1d', now(), now(), $1, $2) RETURNING id
